title: Infosys grew 4.2%, below its final FY25 guidance
summary: Infosys reported 4.2% constant-currency revenue growth and a 21.1% operating margin for FY25.
significance: FY25 growth finished 0.3 percentage points below January’s revised floor. The original 1%–3% forecast excluded the in-tech acquisition. Comparing the revisions shows how management’s expectations changed.

title: FY25 growth and EBIT margin land within guidance
summary: Revenue grew 4.7% on a constant-currency basis and EBIT margin reached 18.3% for the year.
significance: Both outcomes were within the original ranges. Management set a 2%–5% growth range for the next financial year.

title: IT services revenue falls 0.8% sequentially
summary: March-quarter IT services revenue declined 0.8% from December and 1.2% from a year earlier, both in constant currency.
significance: The sequential decline was within January guidance, 0.2 percentage points above the bottom of the range.

title: March-quarter deal wins reach $12.2 billion
summary: TCS reported $12.2 billion of quarterly contract value and $30.18 billion of annual revenue. FY25 operating margin was 24.3%.
significance: The quarterly book-to-bill ratio reached 1.6. Deal value measures contracted business, which can convert into revenue over several periods.

title: Infosys agrees to acquire two specialist consultancies
summary: The deals value Australian cybersecurity firm The Missing Link at up to A$98 million and US energy specialist MRE Consulting at up to US$36 million, including earn-outs.
significance: Both figures are conditional maximums. Management incentives and retention payments fall outside the disclosed consideration.

title: Wipro files copies of newspaper advertisements
summary: The company sent the exchanges copies of its advertisements in the Financial Express and Kannada Prabha.
